milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_wood blocks with the stone_axe drops dark_oak_wood items into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 dark_oak_wood, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block, object=dark_oak_wood) because building an archway gate requires placing blocks in a structure. The player's only building material is mined dark_oak_wood (no planks are given), so checking for dark_oak_wood blocks placed in the cobblestone-marked building area (spawn-relative x=6-14, y=0-5, z=-4 to 4) correctly verifies construction. Requiring min_count=5 ensures a minimal archway shape (e.g., 2 pillars of 2 blocks each + 1 connecting top block). The generous box (±3-5 beyond the cobblestone rectangle at x=8-12, z=-2 to 2) accounts for slight placement variation. This also enforces the dependency: since the player starts with no dark_oak_wood, they must mine it first before placing blocks here.
